cues: Linkage keeps genes together and gives parental combinations; it weakens with distance; it keeps good combinations intact.
Crossing over separates them and gives recombinants; it becomes more frequent with distance; and it creates variation.
text: The comparison to learn. Linkage keeps genes together and gives parental combinations; it weakens with distance; it keeps good combinations intact. Crossing over separates them and gives recombinants; it becomes more frequent with distance; and it creates variation.
